data.desc: Blue Owl Capital Corporation (NYSE: OBDC) is a specialty finance company focused on lending to U.S. middle-market companies. OBDC has elected to be regulated as a business development company under the Investment Company Act of 1940, as amended. OBDC is externally managed by Blue Owl Credit Advisors LLC, an SEC -registered investment adviser that is an indirect affiliate of Blue Owl Capital Inc. ('Blue Owl') (NYSE: OWL) and is a part of Blue Owl's Credit platform.
